message.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Consolidated tables showing an extensive listing of the highest independently confirmed efficiencies for solar cells and modules are presented. Guidelines for inclusion of results into these tables are outlined and new entries since July 2025 are reviewed.</jats:p>
title: Solar Cell Efficiency Tables (Version 67)
